name: Fornicators
overview: Scripture clearly condemns fornication as a sinful work of the flesh that defiles both the individual and the marriage covenant. Jesus highlights fornication as a legitimate cause for divorce, emphasizing the seriousness of sexual sin outside of marriage (Matthew 19:9). The epistles warn believers to mortify sinful desires including fornication, linking it with uncleanness and idolatry (Galatians 5:19; Colossians 3:5). God's judgment is pronounced against those who engage in fornication, as seen in the examples of Sodom and Gomorrah and the ultimate condemnation described in Revelation (Hebrews 13:4; Jude 1:7; Revelation 21:8).
